clue.text: Opera character with title role in musical

definitions.text: Opera character with title role in musical

parts.words: Opera character with title role in musical
parts.note: the masked figure haunting the Paris Opera, who gives his name to Lloyd Webber's long-running show

explanation.surface: A question about which opera character got the lead part in a musical.
explanation.definitionFit: The ghostly figure of the Paris Opera house is the title character of the Lloyd Webber stage show.

clue.text: Artist's a fool to enter religious company

parts.note: PI is short for pious, a crossword staple for religious

indicators.note: the fool goes into the company abbreviation, entering it

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: An artist is mocked as a fool for joining a religious order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'religious company' looks like one phrase (an order of monks) but splits into PI and CO.
explanation.definitionFit: Pablo Picasso was the Spanish painter who co-founded Cubism.

clue.text: Heads off farm lad — will go for this animal

indicators.note: each of the four words farm, lad, will and go loses its leading letter, its head

explanation.surface: A farm boy is told to go off and fetch an animal.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the first letters leaves ARM, AD, ILL and O, which run together to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The armoured, burrowing mammal of the Americas is a creature, so it fits a pointer to an animal.

clue.text: Fish from mouth of Thames to Waterloo

indicators.note: a river's mouth is where it begins its exit, here taken as the first letter of the word Thames

parts.note: a Waterloo is a crushing defeat, a rout, after Napoleon's last battle

explanation.surface: A fish swims from the Thames estuary up to Waterloo in London.
explanation.walkthrough: Waterloo looks like the London station by the Thames; here it is the battle, so a decisive defeat.
explanation.definitionFit: This freshwater game fish of the salmon family is a common species.

clue.text: Maltreat composer's girl, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the phrase is spoken and the answer sounds like it

parts.note: an unmarried daughter of the composer Handel would be addressed as Miss Handel

explanation.surface: Someone mistreats the daughter of a composer, as rumour has it.
explanation.definitionFit: To handle roughly or badly is to treat cruelly, a close synonym.

clue.text: Whatever's available to shoot so-called lady

parts.note: to pot is to shoot game, as in a potshot
luck is personified as Lady Luck, only nominally a lady

explanation.surface: An invitation to shoot at whatever comes along, including a supposed lady.
explanation.definitionFit: A meal or choice taken by chance means accepting whatever happens to be on offer.

clue.text: Board here, and lose weight from the seafood

indicators.note: the weight is taken away from the seafood word, which loses it

parts.note: plankton is the drifting food of the sea that whales feed on
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Advice to dieters at a boarding house: cut down on the seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: A long flat length of timber is a plank, as in walking the plank.

clue.text: Players taking the piano, nonetheless, aboard

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the ship letters take in the shortened instrument, holding it inside

parts.note: aboard means on a steamship, SS

indicators.note: none is read as O, nothing, so the word piano loses its O

explanation.surface: Musicians are carrying the piano on board regardless of difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nonetheless' reads as an adverb but splits into none (O) and less, turning PIANO into PIAN, which sits inside SS.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors are players on the stage, named after Thespis, the founder of Greek drama.

clue.text: Scare for member of Security Council, say

parts.note: the Security Council is an example of a United Nations body, UN
a man is a member of a team or side

explanation.surface: A question of who sits on the United Nations Security Council.
explanation.definitionFit: To deprive someone of courage or nerve is to frighten them.

clue.text: Land nominally associated with Brunel

definitions.meaning: a realm or country ruled by a monarch
the engineer was named Isambard ___ Brunel, so the word is linked with him by name

explanation.surface: A piece of land is named after the great Victorian engineer.
explanation.walkthrough: Isambard Kingdom Brunel was the Victorian engineer who built the Great Western Railway and the Clifton Suspension Bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch's realm is a land, and the word was the engineer Brunel's middle name.

clue.text: Carefully search round group of players

parts.note: to comb an area is to search it thoroughly
a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: Searching carefully around for a group of musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A small jazz or pop band is a group of musicians playing together.

clue.text: Means test upset some politicians

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A benefits means test angers certain politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Senior political leaders respected for wisdom are a class of politicians.

clue.text: Divert team to racecourse

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
a track is a racecourse

explanation.surface: Send the team off to the racecourse instead.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead someone away from the main issue is to distract or deflect them.

clue.text: Languished in wood, then died

parts.note: pine is a kind of wood
d is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone wasted away in a forest and then passed away.
explanation.definitionFit: To waste away from longing or grief is to pine, which means languished in the past tense.

clue.text: Young bird with pained expression suffered

parts.note: ow is a cry of pain
suffered in its old sense of allowed, so let

explanation.surface: A fledgling cried out in pain after an injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffered' looks like it means endured pain; here it is the archaic sense of permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby owl is a young bird.

clue.text: Final steps in ascent? Excellent

definitions.meaning: the uppermost series of stairs reached on a climb

explanation.surface: The last stairs of a climb are judged first class.
explanation.definitionFit: The uppermost set of stairs is the last stage of a climb, and the best division in sport means first-rate.

clue.text: In natural religion, exploit a pessimistic disposition

indicators.note: the exploit is placed inside the word for natural religion

parts.note: deism is belief in God based on reason and nature rather than revelation
a feat is an exploit, a daring deed

explanation.surface: A gloomy outlook can lurk within belief in natural religion.
explanation.definitionFit: Expecting or accepting failure is a gloomy, hopeless attitude.

clue.text: Deliver steering device to coast

parts.note: to deliver is to set free
a wheel is used to steer a car or ship

explanation.surface: Handing over a steering wheel to the seaside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coast' looks like the seashore but is the verb: to move without power.
explanation.definitionFit: To ride downhill without pedalling or engine power is to glide or cruise.

clue.text: Instant vehicles entered time warp

indicators.note: the vehicles go inside the scrambled time letters
the letters of time are twisted out of shape and rearranged

parts.note: media are vehicles, means of conveying information

explanation.surface: A science-fiction scene of vehicles passing through a time warp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'warp' rearranges TIME as IM...TE, with MEDIA entering the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Happening at once with no delay, as instant coffee or an instant reply.

clue.text: Chorus-girl? A fine specimen

definitions.meaning: a chorus girl is jokingly a piece, in old slang a woman, from a show
an item displayed as an outstanding example

explanation.surface: A chorus girl is admired as a splendid example.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical attraction or a prized exhibit, the best item to put on display.

clue.text: Stay at university and fail to keep appointment

parts.note: to stand is to stay or remain in place
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student remains at college and misses a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave a date waiting by not turning up is to jilt them, a phrasal verb.

clue.text: A doctor in South America for number of Brazilians

indicators.note: the A and the doctor go inside the continent's letters

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A physician working in South America for a number of Brazilian patients.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' looks like a count of people but is a musical number, a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The Brazilian dance of African origin is a musical number popular in Brazil.

clue.text: Kennedy or Charles de Gaulle, for example

definitions.text: Kennedy or Charles de Gaulle, for example

parts.words: Kennedy or Charles de Gaulle, for example
parts.note: the two statesmen give their names to major hubs for flights in New York and Paris

explanation.surface: A pair of famous twentieth-century leaders given as examples.
explanation.definitionFit: JFK in New York and Charles de Gaulle in Paris are big international air terminals.

clue.text: Forging equipment concealed in Roman villa

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the run of the words Roman villa

explanation.surface: Blacksmith's tools are found buried in an ancient Roman house.
explanation.definitionFit: The iron block a smith hammers metal on is the basic tool of the forge.

clue.text: Perhaps I swear "hell endlessly

parts.note: to vow is to swear an oath

indicators.note: the word hell loses its ends, keeping only its middle

explanation.surface: Someone swears, cutting short a curse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' looks like the speaker, but it is the letter I, an example of the class.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter I is one of the five letters a, e, i, o, u, so an example of the class.

clue.text: Glaswegian, say, the opposite of a high-flyer

definitions.meaning: a person from the Scottish Lowlands, where Glasgow lies
read literally, one who comes down at a low height, the reverse of a high flyer

explanation.surface: A Glasgow man is described as anything but ambitious.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasgow is in the Scottish Lowlands, and one who touches down low is the reverse of a high-flyer.

clue.text: Desert holiday

definitions.meaning: to desert is to abandon, to go away from
time off work, as in annual or shore ...

explanation.definitionFit: To abandon a place is to quit it, and authorised time off work is a vacation.

clue.text: Continental concealing first 22 in an offence

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, A

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the word for offence

parts.note: a sin is an offence
22 down's answer is a class of letters; the first of those is A

explanation.surface: A European is hiding a first offence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first 22' cross-refers to 22 down: the first of the letters a, e, i, o, u is A.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the continent of Asia; the word names the people of that landmass.

clue.text: To reduce in importance could be dead wrong

indicators.note: indicates that the letters of the phrase may be arranged into something else

explanation.surface: A claim that demoting someone might be utterly mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder; 'could be' rearranges both words.
explanation.definitionFit: To lower in rank or status is to demote.

clue.text: State idea shown to appear pointless

indicators.note: points of the compass, east, south, west and north, are taken out of the words idea shown

explanation.surface: An idea that has been presented turns out to be futile.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing E, S, W and N, the four compass points, leaves the US state's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The north-western American state known for potatoes is one of the fifty states.

clue.text: Colour set? It's equipped for digital input

definitions.meaning: the range of paints an artist works from
the board has a hole for the thumb, a digit, to go through

explanation.surface: A colour scheme has a fitting that takes a finger.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's mixing board holds a range of colours and has a hole for the thumb.

clue.text: Merciful note in Marxist court's conclusion

indicators.note: the note is placed within the revolutionary's name

parts.note: Lenin was the Marxist leader of the Russian revolution
E is a musical note

indicators.note: the conclusion of court's is its final letter

explanation.surface: A lenient sentence at the end of a trial by a Marxist court.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing mildness or tolerance in punishment is to be forgiving.
